name: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What! You again? Well I'll be a monkey's uncle... Except that I'm a gnome. Slicky Gastronome to be precise! So you're back to help out again eh? Well, I can't say as I blame you. Don't you just love the smell of all of that food?
Enough loitering! Get out there and bring me back more rainbow fin albacore!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew that you had it in you, kid. You've got the look of someone who knows what they likes. Specifically that you like pleasing me and the powers that be. And that you have, I guarantee.
Haha, ok, I'll just get these fish properly stashed away, and then you and I can have a little talk concerning you collecting another twenty albacore.
